title: The Many Names of the One Garment: The Living Soul Dispersed
description: A catechesis on naming: every name (Jesus, pearl-ornaments, icons-and-tunics, element of light, Cross of Light, Counsel of Life, afflicted-slain-strangled-dead soul) designates one reality — the Living Soul / Divine Truth dispersed throughout the cosmos. The five noeric ones constitute the body of the Pillar of Glory; the three garments of wind/fire/water clothe the Living Spirit. At the consummation all multiplied names will collapse back into one likeness, one name, in the original substance.
